label: Example A - 304L-like, carbon removal with chromium conservation

recipe.notes: Illustrative demonstration recipe - not a production practice.

unit_system.composition: wt% (mass fraction x 100); ppm displayed for N, S, O
unit_system.gas_flow: Nm3/min at the reported normal reference
unit_system.time: process_time_s (SI seconds from heat start); timestamps ISO-8601 UTC

solver.scheme: event-driven explicit, extent-limited, semi-implicit heat exchange

outputs.item: Metal droplets entrained in slag (yield loss)

mass_totals.note: Inputs include all gases; outputs include vessel off-gas. Difference reflects any accumulated element residual.

energy_closure.basis: Absolute enthalpy (formation + sensible) referenced to elements at 298.15 K; Q>0 leaves the system.

geometry.provenance: SYNTHETIC_DEFAULT design ratios; replace with plant drawings

uncertainty.method: parameter ensemble (n=3, lognormal sigma=0.15 on k_C, k_red_Si, k_Cr, k_N, k_S, heat-loss; DEMO)

prices_used.note: Placeholders only - replace with site tariffs. Prices are per kg unless stated.

assumptions.note: Placeholder assumptions; replace with site factors.

economics.disclaimer: Placeholder prices/factors - user must supply site tariffs.

design.provenance: SYNTHETIC_DEFAULT design ratios; replace with plant drawings

assumptions: AOD = argon-oxygen decarburisation secondary refining of molten stainless steel; DRI (if any) is charged upstream (EAF), never to the AOD.
Lumped metal / slag / gas / additions / lining control volumes; bath is perfectly mixed (optional zoning is a documented extension).
Oxygen distribution by a common interfacial oxygen-potential model with mass-transfer-limited fluxes; no assumption that all O2 goes to carbon.
Thermochemistry: Turkdogan / Sigworth-Elliott literature data with first-order Wagner interaction (DEMO, uncalibrated); licensed CALPHAD adapter optional.
Kinetic coefficients are SYNTHETIC_DEFAULT values - not plant-validated.
Absolute-enthalpy energy balance (formation + sensible, 298.15 K reference); lining by 1D transient conduction; shell convection + radiation; mouth radiation.
Gas volumes at the reported normal reference; vessel off-gas distinct from duct gas (air ingress + hood combustion).
Recipes, grade windows, coolant rules and prices are illustrative demonstration values, not production setpoints or standards.
